title: Bind labels and coordinates to the exact model
symptom: Early messages used numeric class IDs with provisional names and intensity scale. A local label file alone did not prove the export order.
explanation: A model contract needs the exact artifact, its labels, tensor layout and coordinate conventions. Successful deserialization only checks a subset of those assumptions.
steps: Identify the ONNX by SHA-256 rather than by filename.
Compare the repository label file with the recorded exact-version NVIDIA label digest.
Read the decoder convention: XYZ is a geometric box center, dimensions follow local axes and yaw is in radians.
Keep generic display labels and unresolved training semantics separate from the verified artifact facts.
verification: The new read-only check confirms label.txt matches the recorded digest and prints Vehicle/Pedestrian/Cyclist order, axes and remaining contract gaps. No internet lookup or inference is repeated.
remaining_limit: Exact original-training/reference parity, sensor feature equivalence and runtime enforcement of the full semantic contract remain incomplete.

reproduction.kind: read-only artifact/contract audit

visual_suggestion: A derived contract card with the three verified IDs, center convention and a separate unresolved box; use the actual J30 JSON, not a fabricated model screenshot.
visual_after: Exact artifact labels verified; training/input semantics remain partial.

title: Prove the evaluator responds to correct, missing and duplicate predictions
symptom: A plausible score could come from broken matching or ignore logic rather than from the detector.
explanation: Before interpreting a poor model result, controlled predictions must produce known outcomes. A second identical prediction must not reuse one annotation.
steps: Create a known annotated box and an identical prediction in an analytic control.
Remove that prediction and check that one false negative remains.
Add a duplicate and check that only one prediction matches.
Run the existing official KITTI metric controls using the already-cached development kit.
verification: Actual controls print exact=1 TP/0 FP/0 FN, missing=0/0/1, and duplicate=1/1/0 with precision 0.5. The KITTI controls independently use 41 artificial frames per class and check AP_R40=1 for exact boxes.
remaining_limit: These artificial fixtures verify metric behavior. They are not real-world detector observations or evidence of dataset accuracy.

reproduction.kind: controlled analytic failure reproduction and CPU metric tests

visual_suggestion: A three-panel diagram or actual evidence-page table for exact/missing/duplicate counts, explicitly labeled synthetic evaluator controls. Avoid representing the artificial 41 frames as collected scenes.
visual_before:
Missing prediction: 0 TP / 0 FP / 1 FN.
Duplicate: 1 TP / 1 FP / 0 FN.
visual_after:
Exact control: 1 TP / 0 FP / 0 FN.
Official KITTI controls also pass.

title: Put predictions and labels in one coordinate and evaluation frame
symptom: KITTI labels use camera bottom centers; ROS detections use LiDAR geometric centers. Full scans also contain predictions outside the camera-labeled view.
explanation: Comparing raw coordinates or counting every rear-facing prediction as a false positive would produce misleading metrics. Calibration, split and visibility rules must be fixed first.
steps: Load the matching calibration, rectification and camera dimensions.
Convert the annotated bottom center to a geometric center and apply the complete transform.
Check known centers, dimensions, headings and near-plane image clipping with the existing fixtures.
Keep source recording drives separated between the KITTI tuning and test samples.
Apply the declared camera visibility and ignore policy before scoring.
verification: New tests exercise known camera coordinates, nontrivial translated/rectified calibration, outside-camera exclusion and near-plane clipping. The preserved baseline has 2,876 predictions: 862 camera-visible and 2,014 excluded; frozen drive overlap is zero.
remaining_limit: KITTI camera-upright prediction formatting approximates calibration tilt. Small scenario-selected data and unknown pretrained overlap prevent a population or official leaderboard claim.

title: Separate NMS behavior from inference differences

Read the preserved TensorRT 8/10 repeated outputs.
Apply unchanged NVIDIA NMS and project NMS to identical rows.
Match rows uniquely by class and geometric components rather than array order.

Compare these counts with the encoded export limits.
Use the existing small first-pillar/first-point control fixtures to test deterministic selection.

remaining_limit: Two allocation probes do not certify internal tensor bounds, race freedom, leaks, long-run memory stability or complete GPU safety.
